name: Sieng Lao: The One
original_name: ສຽງລາວ: ໜຶ່ງດຽວ
overview: Across two unforgettable nights, Sieng Lao: The One will see a selection of artists compete for the chance to represent Laos at Eurovision Song Contest Asia. Don't miss this trailblazing edition of the show, coming up in late September.
